method.name: real-review bounded evolution
method.summary: Convert real wins and losses into bounded scoring rules, hard constraints, and protected brave behaviors before publishing.
principles: Learn from winning matches and losing matches.
Fatal risks are hard constraints, not small penalties.
Do not let defensive fixes remove star tempo, lane control, or pressure fire.
Keep one rollback baseline and one coherent hypothesis per cycle.
Use live target pools and real challenge batches for ladder evaluation; simulations are only safety checks.
Do not patch from a single fresh loss unless it is a reproducible hard constraint; cluster real replay tags before changing code.

boundedAxes.purpose: Keep visible bullets and close gunlines ahead of value movement without reintroducing shield-specific logic.
requiredTests: v61 handles future bullet danger before taking a clear shot
v61 close gunline counterfires before wandering

boundedAxes.purpose: Use boost only for aligned valuable star routes while preserving near-star walking and adjacent pickup.
requiredTests: v61 takes adjacent safe star before boost or fire
v61 does not cast boost when not facing a useful route
v61 casts boost only for an aligned valuable star route
v61 does not cast boost for a close star it can walk to
v61 boosted near-star control turns instead of overshooting sideways

boundedAxes.purpose: Convert active boost into immediate attack value: same-frame turn-fire or go-plus-free-turn gunline creation.
requiredTests: v61 uses active boost same-frame turn fire on a clear lane
v61 uses active boost move plus free turn to create a gunline

boundedAxes.purpose: Keep the candidate as a small boost-only behavior tree instead of a shield/boost mixed priority stack.
requiredTests: v61 behavior tree is boost-only and excludes shield-pressure branch

protectedBehaviors: Visible bullet danger must be handled before clear shots, boost casts, or star movement.
Close same-row or same-column gunlines must counterfire or exit before wandering.
Adjacent safe stars must be collected before boost, pressure, or patrol actions.
Boost must not be cast when the tank is not already facing a useful star or gunline route.
Boost may be cast for an aligned valuable star route, but not for a close star that can be walked to.
Active boost should create value through same-frame turn plus fire or go plus free turn toward a gunline.
Boosted near-star control must avoid overshooting a one-step star.
The shield-main candidate must stay boost-only and must not reintroduce shield-pressure branches.

publishRequires: pre-publish code quality and strategy-conflict review
npm run simulate with AGENTANK_SHIELD_KEY loaded
shield-main challenge dry-run before any real challenge
explicit user confirmation before real challenge execution
stopAfter: new failure not covered by current bounded axis

driftRules: Do not convert one fresh loss directly into code unless the reviewed hard constraint is reproducible or part of a clustered failure axis.
Do not add a new tactical axis without a required regression test.
Do not optimize only from losses; preserve at least one winning behavior.
Do not publish a candidate whose protected behavior tests fail.
Do not keep raw replay dumps as persistent repo context.
Visual speech may add flavor, but it must not change action selection.
Every reviewed replay must emit preserve, fix, hard-constraint, and brave-baseline buckets.
Use real challenge batches as the decision signal; simulation results are safety checks only.
